messages.author: a7b4b8806b78ccd8
messages.subject: error with finding flywire partners
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to fetch synaptic partners of a flywire neuron in R studio using:
pp=flywire_partners("720575940621039145")

I receive the following error message:

Error in py_get_attr_impl(x, name, silent) :
  AttributeError: 'CloudVolumeGraphene' object has no attribute 'get_roots'

I would appreciate it if you could help.

Thanks
Ibo

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: error with finding flywire partners
parts:
[resending to the list in case it is useful for others – this message was sent directly to Ibrahim]

Dear Ibrahim,

Very likely your version of cloudvolume is quite out of date.

Assuming your fafbseg package is up to date then run

fafbseg::dr_fafbseg()

And let us know what you see. Assuming cloud volume is out of date (current version is 3.8.0) then try running

simple_python()

To update. If you want to use your system python installation

simple_python(miniconda=F)

Should do the trick.

Best,

Greg.
